findings.title: Enforce the documented unit boundary.
findings.rationale: formatDuration(90_000) returns "90s", and formatDuration(3_600_000) returns "60m". Both outputs violate the documented requirement that the whole-number unit stays below 60. parseDuration accepts these values, so this is a reachable behavior. Either enforce the boundary with a defined fallback or update the contract and add boundary tests.
